title: Nat call deck, Thu 8 Oct
source: JEM refresh Thu 8 Oct 2026: only venues that never replied by email or went quiet 14+ days (no live email threads). Clubs first, then longest silence, then closest match to the clubs that book (RBL and ex services, Cons, social, WMC; Essex, London, Kent, Herts first). Real phone required. Built by /workspace/deck-refresh/build_calls.py

freeNights.nights: Saturdays: 2, 9 Jan · 6, 27 Mar · 10 Apr · 22 May · 5, 26 Jun · 24, 31 Jul · Aug fully booked · 11 Sep · 16 Oct · 6, 20 Nov · 11, 18 Dec

rules: Check both calendars before offering any date.
New price: £300 cash for one night of 2 x 1 hour, or £250 a night if they book four dates. Never £250 for a single night and never below £250.
A quote already given stands as quoted. Never restate a fee already agreed.
Cash or books fee only. Never ticket or door deals.
Never offer Sat 17 Oct. NYE is booked.

venues.quote: 10 Sep: £250 cash or £280 on the books for 2 x 1 hour (8 to 11pm). Sharon accepted £250 cash. Only the date is open.
venues.lastMsg: "I will get back to you, just need to juggle some things around."
venues.why: The price is agreed and only the date is open. She wanted 28 Aug 2027 and August 2027 is fully booked, so offer the other 2027 Saturdays on the intro card. Do not restate the fee.
venues.note: Last contact: 17 Sep (Us) · Fee already agreed. Do not restate the fee on the call.

venues.quote: 21 Sep: £250 cash for a Saturday of 2 x 1 hour or £300 for 3 x 1 hour, with 2027 Saturdays 8 May, 22 May, 5 Jun, 24 Jul, 31 Jul. That quote stands. 8 May has since gone; 22 May, 5 Jun, 24 Jul and 31 Jul are still free.
venues.lastMsg: Mags asked the Saturday night charge.
venues.why: Mags asked the Saturday charge, then silence after the quote and our 28 Sep chase. 2027 only, FAR (North Wales), so it needs a weekend run.

venues.quote: 17 Sep they offered £250 for Sat 3 x 45, 9pm to midnight, by bank transfer on invoice. We countered: £250 cash or £275 on the books for 2 x 1 hour, £350 cash or £375 on the books for 3 sets.
venues.lastMsg: They always want new acts for Saturday nights in the Members Bar and pay £250 for 3 x 45 by bank transfer.
venues.why: They have named a budget and a slot, so only the format and fee gap is left. A call can settle it (for example 2 x 1 hour at £275 on invoice) and fix Sat 7 Nov or a 2027 Saturday. Our chase on 28 Sep got no answer.

venues.quote: 16 Sep: £400 for one Saturday of 3 sets, or £350 each for 4. That quote stands.
venues.lastMsg: Julie asked the fee for Sat 8.30 to 11.30, 3 sets.
venues.why: Julie asked the fee herself and went quiet after the quote and our 28 Sep chase. Test her budget and offer Sat 7 Nov or a 2027 Saturday (10 Oct in that quote is gone).

venues.quote: 15 Sep: £300 cash (£330 on the books) for 2 hours or £450 for 3 hours, Sat or Sun. That quote stands.
venues.lastMsg: She asked "What's the fee please?"
venues.why: Conservative club that asked the fee, then silence after the quote and one chase (28 Sep, no more emails). A call checks whether the fee or the distance is the problem. FAR.

venues.quote: 28 Aug: £400 for 3 x 45 on a Saturday night, PA included, no deposit. That quote stands.
venues.lastMsg: Their committee meets on the first Tuesday of every month and Christine would take our 2027 dates to it.
venues.why: Conservative club that asked us for dates. The committee met on Tue 6 Oct, so ring Christine for the verdict. Some dates we sent her have since gone (6 and 13 Feb, 19 Jun, Sun 6 Dec), so use the intro list.

venues.quote: 4 Sep: £250 for a 2 hour show or £375 for 3 hours, Sunday afternoon. That quote stands.
venues.lastMsg: She hadn't forgotten; she was busy and away and would get back "next week".
venues.why: She wants a Sunday afternoon and Sundays are what Jake has free (Sun 11, 18, 25 Oct; 15, 22 Nov; 20, 27 Dec). Natalie's 2 Oct note says Maxine was back from holiday the next day. Local.
venues.note: Last contact: 11 Sep (Them) · Natalie's note 2 Oct: Maxine back from holiday, ring her in the evening.

venues.quote: 7 Sep: £325 cash for a 2 hour show (2 x 1 hour), own PA, no deposit. Saturdays or Sundays only. That quote stands.
venues.lastMsg: Sandie asked for prices for a 2 hour show and said she could not give a date yet.
venues.why: She came to us through the website wanting to book. Jake rang on 14 Sep and Natalie left her number with Donna (bar manager) on 16 Sep. No word since. Weekends only, it is a drive.

venues.quote: 1 Sep: £250 for 2 x 1 hour or £350 for 3 x 45. That quote stands.

venues.note: Last contact: 9 Sep (Us) · Natalie left a voicemail on 2 Oct, no call back yet.
